title: Three sum zero count
statementMd:
Return all unique triplets `[a, b, c]` (sorted ascending inside, and the list of triplets sorted) that sum to zero.

**Example:** `three_sum([-1, 0, 1, 2, -1, -4])` returns `[[-1, -1, 2], [-1, 0, 1]]`.
hints: Sort, fix one value, two pointers for the rest, skip duplicates.
